purpose: Read-back of every registry pin added on 2026-10-14 in packages/core/src/protocols.ts and assets.ts (read-only RPC).
source: core-contracts read-back script, driven by the built @kletia/core registry: every new VENUE_CONTRACTS row, DEX_DEPLOYMENTS entry, new YIELD_VENUES row and new asset.

notPinned.reason: Across Solana spoke program verifies (executable, upgradeable loader) but Across does not list Solana among its networks yet, so the row is left out of VENUE_CONTRACTS.

probeRerun.result: Identity fields (addresses, code presence, factory/router/quoter links, owners, selectors) equal the first probe run of 13:00-13:40 UTC; only live values differ (rates, supplies, oracle rounds, block numbers). The Rocket Pool deposit simulation in probe-staking failed inside the script (viem decode error), not on chain.
